definition: Earlier source evidence must change a later retrieval query, filter or branch. Arithmetic over a fixed collection already containing every decision field is not itself a retrieval dependency.

official_access.annual_metadata: Successful official Atom API pages d0007–d0024 supply the complete current annual inventory. They are explicitly permitted.
official_access.version_metadata: The official API accepts versioned id_list values; d0065, d0103, d0130 and this session's successful d0257 demonstrate batching/version retrieval. No valid API is prohibited.
official_access.bulk_assessment: Inherited API/bulk investigation is preserved in d0071 and related raw evidence. Current metadata inventory supplies current titles and comments, not all selected historical titles. Closed OAI/Kaggle/tool-access failures are not used as proof of logical dependency. No universal impossibility claim is made about every conceivable bulk source.

edges.change: The named work determines the later query and identity branch; the target is not fixed by the annual category query.

edges.from: Source last listed submission plus target submission history
edges.change: The 2022-02-04 source cutoff selects 2010.11327v14 and therefore changes the requested version from the current v15. Selection is direct; 2111.15041 is not substituted transitively.
Both source cutoffs select 2109.03866v1. Its title contains a subtitle absent from the current v2 title, so the saved current-title field cannot answer these rows.

additional_witnesses.finding: Selected v1 title differs from the current title.
Target v2 was submitted 17324 seconds after the source cutoff; latest-current-version substitution is incorrect.

limits: The delivered offline reference naturally computes from saved discoveries. That reproducibility package is not a claim that the discovery process consisted only of fixed downloads. The inherited SGR audit found structural dependency but explicitly did not establish admission or rule out every bulk shortcut.
